name: ParishBoundaries
title: ParishBoundaries
description:
There are eleven parishes, and their boundaries are avaible by worded description and also by a printed map.

The attribute data details the size of each parish and their name. The coastal boundary of all parishes are derived from 1989 data and may differ from coastal boundary data in several instances.
snippet: This data is intended for geographic display and analysis at the national level. The parish boundaries were re-defined in 1989 in order to regularise them to immovable features in the field.   The use of roads and monuments and other stable physical features were used to provide more ease of measurement.
